subject: Not buying the DLC...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have always had a problem with buying additional cars for racing games. I believe that all the cars you ever need should be included on the disc. I will gladly pay for new game modes, additional tracks/map areas, more offline gameplay etc...

I think CG could easily have charged for the bike pack as this included new vehicles, new online gameplay, and new offline gameplay. They could still have given the day/night cycle for free so that everybody has the same online experience. As the bikes can not play in the same online room as the cars, they had an ideal opportunity to sell them as premium DLC... I really don't understand why they gave them away.

If they had of sold the bike pack.. even for a low price like 400 MS points, maybe the price of the Legendary and Toy cars could have been lower.

I have tried the Toy and Legendary cars as Xandu bought the packs for both, but I will not be buying them for myself as I think they are overpriced, they don't provide additional gameplay for me, and as I play in bumpercam view I can't see the car on my screen when I play anyway.

The Boost Specials, which is only 2 additional cars will be 400 points, Cube put up a list of all the prices HERE.

Until the Island comes out, and unless it's 1600 MS points or more, I wont be buying any of the Premium DLC. I would prefer more Gameplay then just more cars, 75+ cars is really more then enough already!

subject: toys for tots?
author: Dodger455
body:
I have to say after playing with the toys for awhile last night, I like them more than I thought I would, and they are almost impossible to wreck.

I loved the Road Rage with the other toy cars, and it was very hard, because of the small size I spun out alot, but big fun.I have not tried the Marked Man yet, but Stunt run was fun.I drove them all, and the takedown 4x4 so far is my favorite with all wheel steering.They all have horns which I didn't know.The toy bike rider is very funny when you just sit there, and he falls asleep, and almost falls off the bike.The paint colors are fun, but the Citizen, and bike, cannot be changed.I will have fun for a couple of weeks on this DLC, and my daughter loved them.There is really nothing bad about them, except they were a little pricey.The fact that they are super strong is good for some flat spin, and barrel roll action.looking forward to some good U tube vids on the toys.

Late.

subject: Pretty Ok Deal
author: manhattan_89
body: I definately agree on the overpricing of the toy cars. In my opinion, they may be cute (especially the bike), but the handling isn't good and I don't find it very enjoyable to play. I did buy the entire package of cars for 1000 points and that included the bike (like was mentioned already by Dodger 455). This was a better deal since they're all about 450 for each package seperately and I believe there were 3 packages to buy. I think this was sadly a waste of points that I could have saved for the next update that CG will be coming out with. Still love the game the same though 😃
